baseline.worktree: Original inventory and both prior uncommitted passes preserved; no backend implementation changed this pass.

scope.meaning: Inline editor diagnostics: cache identity/lifetime, stale async UI/cache publication, cancellation ownership, whole-request deadlines and remote terminal classification.

findings.summary: Global cache crossed Engine/editor remount boundaries and used ambiguous delimiter/32-bit hash identities.
findings.fix: Per-editor eight-second/24-entry cache keyed by exact JSON tuple of Engine URL, target, source and header context.
regressions: cached diagnostics never cross Engine URLs
remounting an editor does not reuse the previous editor or account's cache
source and header context use unambiguous cache identities
equal-length sources with the same old 32-bit hash do not share diagnostics

findings.summary: Late success/errors overwrote current UI; old markers survived debounce and discarded success entered the cache.
findings.fix: Key-bound view and post-await cancellation checks before UI/cache publication; stale markers hidden immediately.
regressions: late success cannot replace current diagnostics or populate a stale cache
late errors cannot erase the current diagnostics
changing source removes old markers and status during debounce

findings.summary: A shared promise used its first editor's AbortSignal; unmounting that editor aborted a surviving consumer.
findings.fix: Remove module-global pending request sharing; independent editor request lifetimes and cancellation.
regressions: one editor's cancellation does not own another editor's request

findings.summary: A loop-only deadline could not interrupt stalled submission/poll/body reads; cancelled late submission entered polling.
findings.fix: 20-second local and 35-second remote total request deadlines, including submission/body/polls; pre-poll cancellation check and one best-effort independent cancel for a known unfinished job.
regressions: remote submission and a stalled poll each have a bounded 35-second total wait
late remote submission after a target switch only cancels its job, without polling or fallback
local deadline also aborts a stalled JSON body after successful headers
cancellation between polls stops the delay and sends exactly one private cancellation

findings.summary: Cancelled/expired remote jobs containing normalized result fields appeared as compiler issues.
findings.fix: Terminal state takes precedence: unavailable with no markers; real compiler rejection remains issues; no redundant cancel for known terminal jobs.
regressions: cancelled and expired remote jobs are unavailable even when they carry a result
completed remote compiler results retain issue/note mapping and never trigger a local run
remote cancellation and expiry show unavailable in the real editor without running or replacing its draft

before_fix.note: Old hook bundled with real React/Chromium; synthetic fetch permits late application continuations. Four preservation cases and one production UI case were added after reproduction. Final harness pauses its clock to avoid host-time drift at exact boundaries.

historical_backend.note: Previous pass only; not rerun or added to this pass's totals.

limitations: Cache isolation follows editor mounting, not cross-tab observation of HttpOnly cookie changes or distributed session revocation.
Saved drafts and persisted target selection are unchanged; source strings are retained by bounded exact cache keys.
Eight-second cache reuse is not proof of current Agent health or new header contents when input context stays unchanged.
Browser suspension affects timers; an aborted browser request or attempted cancellation does not prove server rollback.
Known unfinished jobs receive one best-effort cancel with a separate 10-second deadline; unknown/lost IDs rely on server queue/lease cleanup.
Failed jobs without a compiler report remain indistinguishable from compiler rejection in the existing normalized wire model.
Manual header checks and semantic completion remain separate, unmodified paths.

next.focus: Semantic-completion providers and manual header validation: model/provider lifetimes, late responses and selected-header context. Inspection targets only, not confirmed bugs.
